_README: Human judgement the raw data cannot see. The model reads this file and
applies it on top of the statistical projection, and every applied
override is reported in the output so a projection is never quietly
Keys are FPL web_name values (add "team" to disambiguate duplicates like
the two Hughes). Fields, all optional:
start_prob      0-1, replaces the modelled probability of starting
minutes_note    why -- shown in the email whenever the player appears
system_fit_risk true = new club/role, treat attacking rates as less
reliable and widen the uncertainty band
avoid           true = never recommend transferring this player IN
note            free text carried through to the email

Mosquera.minutes_note: Saliba out injured with no return date; expected to start at CB. Last season's 986 minutes describe a rotation role that no longer applies.
Mosquera.note: Manager judgement, GW1: keep. Minutes history understates his current role.

Rogers.note: Price implies a starter, but he has moved club and how he fits the system is unknown. Not worth the template pull until we see him play.
